title: Management and leadership
description: Become an effective healthcare leader by exploring the theory and practice of management and leadership in subjects purpose-built for nursing and midwifery. You'll gain essential skills in the midwifery-led continuity of care model so that you can interpret, evaluate and apply evidence to inform practice change and improve health outcomes for women and babies. You'll understand key aspects of leadership theory including communication, collaboration, negotiation, critical thinking, problem-solving and conflict resolution. You'll also investigate developmental strategies to support the advancement of both your and your team's leadership capabilities in a nursing and midwifery context.

title: Medical imaging
description:
Build the fundamental knowledge and skills required to care for patients in medical imaging and radiology practice contexts.

Gain specialised skills in complex patient management and nursing practice related to technologies such as x-ray, computed tomography (CT), ultrasound and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Develop critical thinking and problem-solving skills, specialised clinical proficiency, and effective communication skills. Learn how to plan, implement and evaluate medical imaging practice and make independent judgements while working effectively as a member of a multidisciplinary team.

title: Marketing
description:
Gain future-focused knowledge, skills, and industry experience and become a professional marketer.

Master responsible marketing practice, strategies and tactics aligned with industry demands. Analyse the role that social media plays in customer engagement. Utilise marketing metrics to identity content marketing problems and promote desired consumer responses. Apply digital marketing principles to develop corporate solutions. Learn how to analyse the design and operationalisation of successful customer experiences.

title: Neonatal care
description:
Support our youngest patients and their families at the beginning of their journey.

Learn how to deliver supportive and family-centered healthcare to newborn infants that are premature, low-birth weight or sick in the neonatal intensive care setting. Develop a deeper understanding of relationships between theory and evidenced-based practice through critical thinking, systematic analysis, and reflection. Expand your knowledge as you study risks, outcomes and complications related to preterm birth, congenital issues, birth trauma and the long-term impacts of acute neonatal care.

parent_id.value: Curriculum Structure Master Record: Created 16-Aug-2022 02:41:20 PM

title: Networking
description:
Become a critical part of network integrity and business security. Explore the diverse networking space, from programming and information systems to database technology and project management.

You'll gain essential skills in programming, mobile app development, logic and data structures, and computer architecture. Learn fundamentals of network design, routing protocols and switching processes, cybersecurity, and networking design. Then, apply your new skills to real-world challenges as you plan, install and manage local and wide area networks.

parent_id.value: Curriculum Structure Master Record: Created 24-Aug-2022 10:55:43 AM

title: Natural language processing
description:
Shape a tech future that's more human when you explore natural language processing. Using artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML), you'll create systems that exist within the vastness of human experience, to meet complex needs that aren't always easy to communicate.

Teach machines to interpret and respond based on real human syntax and language, with its many variances. Build tools that infer meaning and gain insight outside of simple inputs, capable of engaging with speech, text, media and more to understand and solve problems.

description:
Support our youngest patients and their families facing critical health issues in the first few weeks and months of life.

Learn how to deliver supportive and family-centered healthcare to newborn infants that are premature, low-birth weight or sick in the neonatal special care setting, including how to competently stabilise and manage the deteriorating infant. Expand your knowledge as you study risks, outcomes and complications related to preterm birth, congenital issues, birth trauma and the long-term impacts of acute neonatal care.

title: Ageing and complex care
description:
Build advanced clinical assessment, clinical reasoning and leadership skills to better support adults across systems, settings and society. Implement evidence-based practice and use innovative models of person-centred care.

You'll become a critical contributor to adults across the care continuum, facilitating transitions in care, coordinating care, and incorporating participatory approaches to engagement.

Online workshops are combined with work-integrated learning (WIL) with our health partners. You will develop your problem-solving and communication skills to thrive as part of an interprofessional care team, playing a key role in managing transitions for adults across the continuum of care.

title: Public health
description:
Prevent, promote and protect – learn about the three Ps of public health and how to apply these to different aspects of public health.  

This specialisation will provide you with the necessary knowledge and skills to understand the health of populations, the role of the determinants of health, policy approaches to public health challenges, and how to respond to public health emergencies and disasters.  

You’ll know how and be able to apply the three Ps of public health and contribute to initiatives to prevent poor health, promote good health, and protect population health.

title: Perioperative practices
description:
Perioperative practice is the care of a patient before, during and after surgery.
 
In this specialisation, you will enhance your clinical skills and knowledge in perioperative practice, advancing your critical thinking and problem-solving abilities to become a proficient healthcare practitioner. The course explores the perioperative nursing roles of instrument and circulating nurses, as well as anaesthesia and recovery nursing in the operating theatre environment, with scaffolded learning to integrate evidence-based practice into your delivery of high-quality patient care. You will build on your understanding of essential technical and non-technical skills, such as communication, teamwork, leadership and professional practice to effectively collaborate within multidisciplinary teams, contribute to quality improvement and enhance patient outcomes.

parent_id.value: Curriculum Structure Master Record: Created 16-Aug-2022 03:00:06 PM

title: Project management
description:
Become the driving force behind project success. Learn to deliver next level outcomes, deftly handling deadlines, suppliers, milestones and risks.

You'll gain advanced skills in leading projects and ensuring organisational excellence by providing strategic advice and managing stakeholders, as you explore subjects like project planning, quality management, risk mitigation, regulatory compliance, and resource management. Then, take the opportunity to connect with other professionals to develop effective techniques for projects of any scope.

parent_id.value: Curriculum Structure Master Record: Created 16-Aug-2022 03:33:48 PM

title: Research
description: Identify a midwifery-related issue you wish to explore and be supported by academic supervisors to plan and conduct a research project. Gain essential skills in the midwifery-led continuity of care model so that you can interpret, evaluate and apply evidence to inform practice change and improve health outcomes for women and babies. Learn the foundations of research in the research pathway, including ethical considerations, study design, proposals and literature reviews, data collection and analysis, and research dissemination. Or be supported in the project pathway to undertake a project to focus your studies and develop unique skill set. You'll graduate with a strong foundation to start your career in midwifery research.

title: Quantum computing
description:
Lead the transition to quantum computing that's transforming the digital economy, logistics, security and intelligence.

Master complementary skills in physics, computer science, mathematics and engineering to develop quantum readiness strategies to apply to practical business solutions. Explore the core principles and underlying technologies of quantum computing and communications, including programming and algorithm design. Study key application areas such as cybersecurity, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning and cryptography.

title: Sex, health and society
description:
Explore contemporary issues, research and thinking on sex, sexuality and sexual health. Unpack how issues related to sexual health can be better understood through a deeper appreciation of the social and cultural aspects of sexuality, sex and relationships.

Delve into Australia's response to HIV, the history of politics of sexuality and education in Australian schools, and the complexity of implementing sexual health policy. Graduate with a strong grasp of critical sexuality studies and an understanding of how to apply it to policy and practice in the field.
